name: dsh-themes
description: Appearance & themes plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): built-in palettes, light/dark/system mode, and VS Code theme import.

scripts.deploy: vp pack && mkdir -p ~/.dsh/dsh-themes/dist && cp dist/client/index.cjs ~/.dsh/dsh-themes/dist/client.cjs && cp dist/host/index.cjs ~/.dsh/dsh-themes/dist/host.cjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check-vs-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-locales.mjs && node scripts/check-bundles.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/check-vs-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-locales.mjs && node scripts/check-bundles.mjs && node scripts/e2e-import.mjs
